step.label: Receive and Log Customer Service Request
step.description: Capture incoming customer orders and service tickets to initiate the supply chain workflow.
step.useCase: Service desk receives customer order for materials and logs it as a tracked service ticket.

step.label: Assess Vendor and Material Compliance Risk
step.description: Evaluate compliance and safety risks associated with requested materials and vendors before procurement.
step.useCase: Compliance team screens hazardous substances and vendor qualifications against regulatory requirements.

step.label: Identify Suitable Vendors and Materials
step.description: Source compliant vendors and materials from the procurement database that meet operational and safety standards.
step.useCase: Procurement specialist queries approved vendors and materials inventory to match customer demand.

step.label: Validate Supply Chain Continuity
step.description: Confirm vendor capacity, material availability, and supply chain resilience for the procurement request.
step.useCase: Supply chain manager verifies vendor lead times and material stock levels to ensure order fulfillment.

step.label: Analyze Production Incidents and Safety Records
step.description: Review historical incident and safety data for materials and vendors to identify operational risks.
step.useCase: Operations team examines incident patterns and safety metrics to mitigate production risks.

step.label: Assess Production Workforce and Capacity
step.description: Evaluate workforce capability, staffing levels, and production capacity to deliver the ordered materials on time.
step.useCase: Production manager validates machine availability and team capacity against the procurement timeline.

step.label: Review Employee Compensation and Labor Costs
step.description: Confirm workforce compensation structures are aligned with labor cost budgets for the procurement order execution.
step.useCase: Finance team validates that employee compensation projections fit within procurement project budgets.

step.label: Provision Access and Execute Order
step.description: Grant system access permissions and orchestrate the final order fulfillment across all stakeholder systems.
step.useCase: Systems administrator activates vendor accounts, material transfers, and order execution workflows.
